title: 第357章 追击战第358章 命运呐
slug: 穿越源卡大陆我自带融合卡牌
lines: “团长大人，奥尼克斯毕竟是熔岩王国的二王子，圣炎小队的队员也都是各个贵族势力的勋贵子弟。”
安琪拉望着林奇手中不断抛出卡牌，还有他脸上那近乎变态的兴奋笑容，心中的担忧愈发浓烈。
“若是他们在这场两国交流赛中出了意外，熔岩王国必然会迁怒于凛冬王国，到时候两国很可能会爆发战争的。”
“熔岩王国和凛冬王国会打起来？”
林奇一脸错愕，眼底闪过一丝警惕。
“那在秘境卡内的情况，外面的人能看到吗？”
若是这里的一切能被外面实时看到，那他们今天这番算计，可就彻底玩大了。
一旦暴露身份，必然会被两大王国联手追杀。
安琪拉摇摇头，“这点您放心，秘境卡是独立的特殊空间，隔绝了外界所有探查。哪怕是映照之书也无法探查到里面的任何动静，更别说实时观测了。”
映照之书都看不到？
林奇眼前一亮，心中的担忧瞬间烟消云散。
脸上的兴奋笑容再次浮现，甚至比之前更加浓烈。
“那就好。只要没人知道这里发生了什么，就让这两方人马打得越惨烈越好。”
若是两大王国真的爆发战争，他说不定能从中大捞一笔。
毕竟他手中还存放着从黑炎伯爵那里缴获的大批军需物资，
这些东西在和平时期不值一提，可到了战争时刻，每一件都是供不应求的硬通货，随便出手就能赚得盆满钵满。
“快快，你们都把制服穿上。”
话话间，林奇便率先披上了黑色长袍，戴上了狰狞的恶鬼面具，眼底闪烁着搞事的光芒。
“没必要玩这么大吧？”
杰克一脸汗颜。
他太清楚这身衣服的含金量了。
每次林奇穿上这套亡灵骑士团的制服，都会闹出惊天动地的大事。
第一次穿，林奇就带着他斩杀了黑炎伯爵。
第二次穿，又领着他覆灭了霍邱堡。
杰克感觉，再这么闹下去，亡灵骑士团迟早要在各个公国和王国之间出名。
而他只是一个六星御卡大师，根本经不住这么折腾，再这么下去很容易会被玩死的。
很快，林奇便已穿戴完毕，冰冷沙哑的声音透过恶鬼面具传出。
“快点穿上。若是被他们用什么侦察手段看到我们的面容，我们今天所做的一切就都白费了，到时候麻烦就大了。”
“还有，杰克你往前坐坐，我们三个人骑着一匹皇家狮鹫，我的猎空螳螂也不要暴露了。”
猎空螳螂是特殊进阶而来的昆虫卡兽，外形罕见，能力也极具标志性。
若是现在暴露，以后他再踏入熔岩王国境内很容易就会被人认出来。
而皇家狮鹫就不一样了，这种卡兽十分普遍，只要是公国内的贵族都能轻易弄到，根本不会引人怀疑。
杰克无奈地叹了口气，披上黑袍、戴好面具，默默往前挪了挪，给林奇腾出位置。
安琪拉还在犹豫，不知道自己该坐在哪里才合适。
林奇却没给她多想的机会，身形一跃，稳稳坐在了杰克身后。
倒骑着皇家狮鹫，与安琪拉面对面凑在了一起。
content_en:
"Master Captain, Onyx is the second prince of the Lava Kingdom after all, and the members of the Holy Flame Team are also noble children of various noble forces."
Angela looked at the cards that Lynch kept throwing out in his hand, and the almost perverted excited smile on his face, and the worry in her heart became more intense.
"If something happens to them in this exchange match between the two countries, the Lava Kingdom will definitely be angry with the Winter Kingdom, and a war will probably break out between the two countries."
"Will the Lava Kingdom and the Winter Kingdom fight?"
Lin Qi looked stunned, with a hint of vigilance flashing in his eyes.
"Can people outside see what's going on inside the secret realm card?"
If everything here can be seen in real time by the outside world, then their plan today will be completely grand.
Once his identity is exposed, he will inevitably be hunted down by the two kingdoms.
Angela shook her head, "Don't worry about this. The secret card is an independent special space, isolated from all outside detection. Even the Book of Reflection cannot detect any movement inside, let alone observe it in real time."
Can’t even see the Book of Reflections?
Lin Qi's eyes lit up, and the worries in his heart disappeared instantly.
The excited smile appeared on his face again, even stronger than before.
"That's good. As long as no one knows what happened here, let the two parties fight as fiercely as possible."
If a war really broke out between the two kingdoms, he might be able to make a huge fortune from it.
After all, he still has a large amount of military supplies seized from Earl Black Flame in his hands.
These things are not worth mentioning in peacetime, but in times of war, each of them is hard currency in short supply, and you can make a lot of money by just selling it.
"Quickly, you all put on your uniforms."
As he spoke, Lynch took the lead in putting on a black robe and a ferocious ghost mask, with a trouble-making light flashing in his eyes.
"There's no need to play it so big, right?"
Jack looked ashamed.
He was very aware of the gold content of this outfit.
Every time Lynch puts on this uniform of the Undead Knights, earth-shattering things happen.
The first time he wore it, Lynch led him to kill the Black Flame Earl.
The second time he wore it, he led him to destroy Fort Huoqiu.
Jack felt that if things continued like this, the Knights of the Dead would sooner or later become famous among the various principalities and kingdoms.
And he is just a six-star card master. He cannot withstand such torture. If he continues like this, he will easily be killed.
Soon, Lynch had finished dressing up, and a cold and hoarse voice came out through the evil ghost mask.
"Hurry up and put it on. If they use some reconnaissance method to see our faces, everything we have done today will be in vain, and we will be in big trouble by then."
"Also, Jack, please sit forward. The three of us are riding a royal griffon, and my Tracer Mantis shouldn't be exposed."
Tracer Mantis is a specially advanced insect monster with a rare appearance and iconic abilities.
If he is exposed now, he will be easily recognized when he steps into the Lava Kingdom in the future.
But the Royal Griffin is different. This kind of card beast is very common. As long as the nobles in the principality can get it easily, it will not arouse suspicion at all.
Jack sighed helplessly, put on his black robe and mask, and silently moved forward to make room for Lynch.
Angela was still hesitating, not knowing where she should sit.
Lin Qi didn't give her a chance to think too much. He jumped up and sat firmly behind Jack.
Riding the Royal Griffin upside down, he came face to face with Angela.
